purpose: Simulated monthly customer × business unit commercial context in the shape a Prism / BTX-data-lake extract will produce. Feeds Account Attractiveness scoring (BTX Commercial Adjacency, Addressable BTX Work), the CommercialAlertEngine (bookings-decline, customer-inactivity), and Account 360's revenue/bookings history. Includes long-form monthly rows plus pre-derived TTM aggregates per customer × BU.

truth_rules.shape_faithful: Grain is customer × BU × month for revenue/bookings; TTM aggregates derived server-side. Real lake column names TBD from Alan; the domain-facing shape is CommercialContext + MonthlyCommercialHistory from domain/commercial.py.
truth_rules.scale_realism: Lockheed anchored as largest (3x tier-1 baseline per your attestation). Tier 2 customers get ~25% of Lockheed. Tier 3 ~8%. Prospects have no monthly rows.
truth_rules.provenance: Every record is synthetic and marked data_mode=SAMPLE, synthetic=true. No real BTX customer commercial data is asserted.
truth_rules.capacity_note: No capacity data included; capacity is derived from production history per Alan and belongs in a separate derived table.
